content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know the pin output order for the [article_no] cable and the [product_name], as I am unable to locate the programming cable. I plan to complete a project using a USB to TTL CP2102 for communication between the PLC and a PC. (translated by Google)
Please refer to the attached file. Note that the interface is not isolated from the supply voltage of the [product_name], which is why optocouplers are included in the [company_name] cable.
Thank you! Regarding adding optocouplers to the USB connection, what components are needed for installation, and in what way should they be set up?
Can this module be applied here in some way?
It's easiest to purchase the official [product_name] cable, available online for about €26.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are looking for ways to connect a [product_name] PLC to a PC using third-party components since the official programming cable is hard to find. The conversation demonstrates concerns about technical aspects like pin assignment and the importance of electrical isolation, generally solved by optocouplers in the original cable. There is also a need for accessible instructions and guidance for those creating DIY wiring solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking detailed instructions for pin configuration of the [company_name] programming cable and advice on how to safely add electrical isolation when using third-party adapters.
